title: Digital Marketing Executive (Social Media)
description:
FindCore are thrilled to be assisting a leading not-for-profit organisation with the recruitment of a Marketing Executive (Social Media & Content).

The role will be based in Cheadle, Greater Manchester, and will focus on growing organic reach, engagement and income across the organisation's established social media channels.

Salary

£35,000 - £45,000, depending on experience + great benefits.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop engaging social media content across a range of established platforms.
- Help grow organic reach, engagement and income through social media activity.
- Plan and deliver content aligned with wider marketing and fundraising objectives.
- Manage content across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and X.
- Create and adapt content including short-form video, social copy and campaign assets.
- Monitor performance and use analytics to improve future content and campaigns.
- Support paid social activity where required.
- Work closely with wider digital and fundraising teams on integrated campaigns.
- Identify emerging social media trends and opportunities to grow audiences.
- Use AI and digital tools to support content creation, reporting and campaign development.

Skills & Experience
- 2+ years' experience within social media, content marketing or digital marketing.
- Proven experience growing social media reach and engagement.
- Strong copywriting and content creation skills.
- Good understanding of social media analytics and performance reporting.
- Experience with paid social, SEO or creator content would be beneficial.
- Comfortable using AI-powered content tools as part of the creative process.
- Strong communication, organisation and project-management skills.

What's on Offer
- Salary of £35,000 - £45,000 depending on experience.
- Opportunity to join a purpose-led not-for-profit organisation.
- Varied role combining social media, content creation and digital marketing.
- Opportunity to work across large-scale digital and fundraising campaigns.
- Cheadle-based position.

For further information on this opportunity, or any other jobs, please apply via the link below or contact FindCore in the strictest confidence.

title: Marketing Executive (35k - 45k)
description:
FindCore are thrilled to be assisting a leading not-for-profit organisation with the recruitment of a Social Media Executive.

The role will be based in Cheadle, Greater Manchester, and will focus on developing new social media income streams, growing supporter acquisition and creating innovative digital fundraising campaigns.

Salary

£35,000 - £45,000, depending on experience + great benefits

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and test new social media fundraising and supporter acquisition opportunities.
- Build campaigns across influencer, affiliate and creator partnerships.
- Identify opportunities to generate income through emerging social platforms and digital formats.
- Work with creators, partners and online communities to increase reach and engagement.
- Plan and deliver social media campaigns, challenges and competitions designed to drive supporter growth.
- Analyse campaign performance and use data and insights to improve results.
- Support paid social and digital partnership activity.
- Work closely with internal marketing and digital teams on campaign strategy.
- Identify new trends, platforms and monetisation opportunities across social media.
- Support the continued growth of digital fundraising activity.

Skills & Experience
- 2+ years' experience within social media, influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, partnerships or digital fundraising.
- Strong understanding of social media platforms and emerging digital trends.
- Experience delivering campaigns focused on income generation, acquisition or measurable growth.
- Comfortable analysing campaign data and performance.
- Strong communication, relationship-building and project-management skills.
- Experience with paid social or social commerce would be advantageous.
- Charity, not-for-profit or fundraising experience would be beneficial but is not essential.

What's on Offer
- Salary of £35,000 - £45,000, depending on experience.
- Opportunity to work within a purpose-led not-for-profit organisation.
- Varied role covering social media, digital fundraising and partnerships.
- Opportunity to develop innovative campaigns and new income streams.
- Cheadle-based position.

For further information on this opportunity, or any other jobs, please apply via the link or contact FindCore in the strictest confidence.
